svg.title: From IPv6 bytes to the Internet struct
svg.desc: The book's TCP SYN carried by IPv6, 32 bits per row: the 40-byte fixed header, with its Next header byte 00 announcing a Hop-by-Hop extension, the 8-byte extension header, then the TCP segment. The struct gets source 2001:db8::1, destination 2001:db8::2, payload_protocol Some(Tcp) from the end of the extension chain, and the 40-byte payload after it.
